source: due2-native: a concept right operand in none of its operand's schemes (decisions/0015 #8; issue #69)
notes: Authored for due2. ex:Telemarketing has a broader edge into the scheme but no membership, and membership is not inherited along skos:broader (due2-profiles.md §6). The policy is valid ODRL 2.2; the rejection is due2's own.

expected_rejection.why: ex:Telemarketing, the right operand of a concept-scheme operand, is in none of its schemes by the memberships the policy and its modules declare, so every request would give U. due2-profiles.md §4 rejects it at normalisation with OperatorTypeMismatch.
